opennyai_summary.decision:
ORDER This petition is filed by the accused Nos.1, 2 and 4 under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C for passing the criminal proceedings in C.C.No.28991/2021 arising out of crime No.20/2021 registered by the Basavanagudi Police Station and charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Sections 498 (A)
read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
1961.
During the pendency of the case, petitioners and respondent No.2 appears through their counsel and filed joint application under Section 320 read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeking permission of this Court to compound offence.
Submission is placed on record.
Respondent No.2 has no objection to quash the proceedings and both of them reunited.
In view of the reunion of the family, the application is allowed.
3. Consequently, the petition is allowed.
Criminal proceedings against accused Nos.1, 2 and 4 is herby quashed.
